_comment: Register field positions measured on physical silicon where the device header and the reference manual disagree. pipeline/extract/rm/extract_registers.py appends the measurement to the evidence row's basis as `<method>:<probe>(=<bits>)`; the row stays `conflict` because the documents still disagree. tools/build_index.py adopts the measured bits in index/registers.csv (the same rule as F-41, where the index takes the RM grid's value). This file never creates a field; it only settles a position a document already states.

measured.how: ch32rv wrote option bytes data0=0x5a, data1=0xc3 on a CH32L103C8T6, then FLASH_OBR (0x4002201C) read 0x0c35acfc: [19:12]=0x5a, [27:20]=0xc3; the header's [17:10]/[25:18] would give 0x6b/0x0d. The same procedure on V203 (0x030d68fc) and V003 (0x030d6bdc) gives 0x5a/0xc3 at [17:10]/[25:18].
